Triaxial compression test on RS soil (Red Crushed Volcanic Scoria (narrowly graded)), intermediate; apparatus: triaxial machine (F2-26); loading: triaxial compression. Recorded: friction angle and apparent cohesion (numbers in text only).

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The measurements of this test have not been digitized yet; the setup and the source pages are indexed. The setup below rests on two agent readings of the report that were reconciled; no person has checked it yet. The test setup is incomplete: relative density Dr, tool, bin or mold, fill depth, rate are not reported.
:::
